Appendix (Rules for the Implementation of the Personnel Regulations of the Ministry of National Defense and its Affiliated Institutions) <No. 646, March 4, 2008>

Article 1 (Effective Date) This regulation shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 Omitted

Article 3 (Amendments to Other Regulations) ① to ⑨ Omitted

⑩ The following parts of the "Rules for the Implementation of the Order for the Implementation of Student Military Training" are amended:

Paragraph 1 of Article 9 and Paragraph 2 of Article 10 and Article 11 are changed to "Minister of Education, Science and Technology".

⑪ Omitted
